messages:
Meera: PTAL — addressed the review comments from yesterday. Split perf tests into a separate job (ci/perf), added a smoke script at ./scripts/smoke_inference.sh, and fixed the kv-cache edge case. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/922

Alex: quick q — did you keep the old batching defaults for Dedicated mode? worried about a latency regression if we change the default behaviour.

Meera: kept the defaults for now but added a canary-safe flag in the config: 'workload_burst_enabled=false' for the rollout. snippet below:
```
# config snippet in runtime/config/defaults.yaml
batching:
  default_max_batch: 128
  workload_burst_enabled: false
```

ci-bot: CI / PR checks — smoke job passed ✅ (build #4821). Perf job queued (job 4822). Logs: https://ci.internal.redwood/jobs/4821

Sam: scanned the changes — one tiny nit: prefer structured log keys (request_id) instead of printf in runtime/log.go. otherwise looks good.

Jordan: can we schedule a short canary tomorrow morning (08:30 PT)? want to run ~1h at 10% traffic and watch p99s + errors.

Meera: scheduled the canary window for 2026-03-18 08:30-09:30 PT and added notes to the rollout doc: https://docs.internal.redwood/rollouts/922. also added a smoke-check webhook to auto-rollback on auth failures.

Lia: heads-up — there's a conflict with platform/main after the recent infra change. please rebase before merge.

Meera: rebased on platform/main and force-pushed + fixed the broken auth test. ran unit and smoke locally.

Alex: ran a quick perf with a small trace set: p50 ~42ms (baseline 40ms), p95 ~120ms (baseline 115ms). looks within noise for these traces, but will run a full perf run after canary.

Sam: I squashed the fixups and left one commit for the smoke script. PTAL for final ok so this can get merged in the next merge slot.

Meera: thanks — pinging the channel for final eyes. if there are no objections i'll merge after the canary completes and checks are green. :thumbsup: :party-parrot:
